description: A input with simple and 3d styling.
howItWorks: Click into it (or tab to it) and it lights up while it has focus.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Weak Wombat 42</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by escannord - https://uiverse.io/escannord/weak-wombat-42 */
/* From Uiverse.io by escannord  - Tags: simple, 3d, input */
.input {
  max-width: 190px;
  height: 2rem;
  background-color: transparent;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  color: white;
  padding: 1rem;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 5px black, inset 2px 2px 5px rgb(53, 51, 51),
    -1px -1px 20px rgba(59, 56, 56, 0.781);
  outline: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: medium;
}

.input:focus {
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 5px black, inset 2px 2px 5px black,
    -1px -1px 5px rgba(68, 67, 67, 0.781),
    inset -1px -1px 5px rgba(66, 65, 65, 0.822);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input class="input" placeholder="typed here..." name="text" type="text" />
</body>
</html>
